# XMG NEO 16 E25 — current orderability

- Official live configurator: https://bestware.com/en/xmg-neo-16-e25.html
- Official technical page: https://www.xmg.gg/en/xmg-neo-16-e25/
- Bestware currently presents the E25 as configurable and addable to cart, with EU shipping and an indicated additional delivery time of 10–14 days.
- The availability notice specifically marks the **standard IPS + RTX 5070 Ti/5080 combinations** sold out. Other combinations are shown as components in stock. The RTX 5080 with Mini-LED remains represented as a selectable/current route.
- RTX 5080 specification is 150 W TGP plus 25 W Dynamic Boost; XMG explicitly states 175 W sustained GPU-only capability with air cooling.
- The Mini-LED option is matte, 2560×1600, 300 Hz, 750-nit SDR/1000-nit HDR and 100% sRGB/DCI-P3 by specification.
- The chassis has aluminium lid, top and bottom, a 123×77.5 mm Microsoft Precision glass touchpad, 99.8 Wh battery, 2.5GbE, Thunderbolt 4, two SO-DIMMs and two M.2 slots.

## Regional/transaction boundary

This proves that the **2025 E25 is orderable**, not the separately announced 2026 290HX Plus refresh. A recommendation still needs a saved final Belgian basket showing RTX 5080, Mini-LED, 32GB or more, at least 1TB, physical keyboard choice, Windows choice, warranty tier and total Belgian checkout price.
